title: How To Use Battle Ropes
hook: Battle ropes are an incredible total body cardio workout. Here's how to use them.
body: Loop the ropes around a pillar or tree. Stand at the end of the ropes with your feet shoulder width apart, a slight bend in your legs, and grab the rope with both hands. For a less intense workout, do alternating waves. Hold one end in each hand and move your arms up and down in a whip-like motion to send waves towards the anchor. For a more intense total body workout, do two arm slams. Lift both arms overhead and slam the ropes down using your entire body.
close: Leave me a comment to let me know your favorite way to do battle ropes.

youtube_description:
Battle ropes are an incredible total body cardio workout, and here's how to use them. Loop the ropes around a pillar or tree. Get in your starting stance with your feet shoulder width apart and a slight bend in your legs. If you want a less intense workout that focuses on your upper body, do alternating waves. If you want a more intense total body workout, try two arm slams. Lift both arms overhead and slam the ropes down onto the floor. I love battle ropes for home cardio because you can set them up anywhere and get a great workout in a matter of minutes.
